description: This file contains test cases for Vitest configuration, including helper functions for resolving worker limits and scheduling, parsing process stats, and default configuration. It uses 'vitest', includes tests for various scenarios, and references configuration and system load modules.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Returns the default pool configuration for Vitest (set to 'threads').

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of local workers for Vitest based on system and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Decides how to schedule Vitest workers based on system load and other active processes.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Parses process statistics to count other Vitest roots and workers, excluding the current process.
